notes.title: We're at BIC 2023!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/6188768/aaac2e1e43d966ea6924a3b9942d74649ff1956f.jpg[/img]

PsychoFlux Ent. partners' games are on display at Busan Indie Connect Festival(BIC) 2023!

Meet us at BEXCO in Busan, South Korea, or visit [url=https://bicfest.org/]bicfest.org[/url] to try games! (Some demos are also available through Steam.)
